request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Recolour as a liquorice galleon and change no shape: the hull becomes black liquorice #23192b, with a paler #5a4c6e highlight and one thick rim of bright pink #ff8fc0 and white stripes in place of the frosting; the sails become white with two bright pink stripes; the masts black; the pennants lemon yellow #ffe04a; the cake tower white sugar with a black top. Keep every shape, the size, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
